Batch crawl of 2 seed URLs with links to discover

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import CrawlConfig, batch_crawl, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_depth=1, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    urls = ["https://example.com/seed1", "https://example.com/seed2"]
    result = await batch_crawl(engine, urls)
    print(result.completed_count)
    print(result.failed_count)
    print(result.total_count)

asyncio.run(main())
```
